name: guild-dose-pooled
cmd: set -e; C=$(ls -d {outroot}/E047/cropat-types-*/ | head -1)cropat_27km.npz; D=${HOUFIN_DATA}/avonet; for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1; do {python} research/exp/guild_dose.py --cache {cache}/$c --cropat $C --avonet $D/TraitData/AVONET1_BirdLife.csv --taxonomy $D/eBird_taxonomy.csv --out {out}/$c --pooled; done
summarize: for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1; do {python} research/exp/guild_dose.py --summarize {out}/$c; done
note: E049b: guild-pooled (one map per guild) crop-type dose-response within type and kernel-local: grassland vs forest birds, CropAT vs LUH
